title: Gate-kill guard passes vacuously when the kill lands after rejoinGrace
body:
TestAGateWhoseKillMissesAMemberReleasesItsSlotAnyway assumes the gate's kill is delivered within the joiner's 500ms rejoinGrace after GO.

On a loaded host the kill can land after the joiner has rejoined the group. The single kill then reaches it, and the test passes even with settleKilledGate removed. The guard does not fail falsely, but it can silently stop guarding.

The rejoin should be scheduled on an observable, for example a file the test writes after shell.wait's first kill is sent, rather than on a 500ms sleep.
evidence: internal/reconcile/testdata/gatejoiner/main.go:37,72 (rejoinGrace); internal/reconcile/gatedir_orphan_unix_test.go:211-213
